name: AI in Financial Services: The One-Hour Briefing
description: A free one-hour briefing built on eight real financial-services jobs, not an overview: spreading financials for a credit memo, writing adverse-action reasons from an ML score, drafting a SAR narrative, setting fraud-score thresholds, checking an earnings-call summary, reviewing an advisor's AI meeting note, summarizing a commercial loss run and reviewing a photo-based auto estimate. Each lesson shows where AI helps, where it must not decide, and the rule that governs that task.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI in Financial Services: The One-Hour Briefing

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 9 lessons in 3 modules; and pass the final exam: 10 questions, 15 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits

alignment.targetName: Check an AI-drafted credit-memo section, SAR narrative, earnings-call summary or loss-run summary against its source and find invented figures, wrong periods, misattributed quotes, paid-versus-incurred errors and omitted facts
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Identify, for a named banking, payments, wealth or insurance task, the step AI may support and the decision a qualified person must make, citing the rule that applies (Regulation B 1002.9(b)(2), 31 CFR 1020.320 or 1022.320, Regulation E 1005.11 or Regulation Z 1026.13, FINRA Rules 2210 and 3110, the NAIC Model Bulletin)
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Explain which AI uses fall inside SR 26-2's definition of a model, which banks the guidance is aimed at, why generative and agentic AI are excluded by its footnote 3, and what governance a bank still owes those tools
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Compute precision, recall and the false-positive ratio for a fraud score at several thresholds from a synthetic transaction file and justify a threshold in terms of losses, customer friction and Regulation E or Regulation Z dispute duties
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Decide whether a given workflow step may use an external AI tool, applying SAR confidentiality, GLBA safeguards, MNPI controls, client-consent and books-and-records requirements
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes
